name: Valterra Platinum Limited
source: CRON 2026-11-21: FY2025 to FY2021 rebuilt from the audited consolidated statement of comprehensive income. FY2025 and FY2024 from Valterra Platinum Audited annual financial statements 2025, page 22 (net revenue 116,330 / 108,987; cost of sales 87,772 / 90,769; gross profit 28,558 / 18,218; profit before taxation 22,290 / 9,679; taxation 6,477 / 2,286). FY2023 and FY2022 from Anglo American Platinum Annual Financial Statements 2023, consolidated statement of comprehensive income (net revenue 124,583 / 164,090; cost of sales 103,570 / 93,578; gross profit 21,013 / 70,512; profit before taxation 18,109 / 66,768). FY2021 from Anglo American Platinum Annual Financial Statements 2022, comparative column (net revenue 214,568; cost of sales 109,456; gross profit 105,112; finance income 713; finance costs 357; profit before taxation 108,311; taxation 29,290; profit for the year 79,021). The statement prints no operating profit line: Operating Profit (EBIT) is profit before taxation plus net finance costs, and Operating Expenses is gross profit less that figure, which equals the sum of the items the statement prints between gross profit and profit before taxation (other income, fair value movements, share of equity-accounted results, expected credit losses, finance costs and income excluded from net finance costs, market development, scrapping and other expenditure) to the rand in every year. Net Profit is profit for the year before non-controlling interests (FY2025 15,813 of which 15,420 attributable to owners; FY2024 7,393 of which 7,059; FY2023 13,446 of which 13,040; FY2022 49,296 of which 49,153; FY2021 79,021 of which 78,978), so profit before taxation less taxation equals it exactly. EPS stays the diluted figure as printed (58.44, 26.78, 49.47, 186.49 rand per share). FY2021 cost of sales and gross profit corrected from the same audited statement (109,456 and 105,112, previously 109,409 and 105,159). Amounts in ZAR, scaled from R million.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file
